description_en: Queries whether your Alibaba Cloud account has the transit router feature activated
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号是否已开通转发路由器服务
name: CheckTransitRouterService

parameters.description_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，需保证该参数在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
